title: Each type in a university group project
caption:
Every university group project has all 16 types, and one person doing everything.

One rewrote the report at 3 am. One designed a gorgeous title slide and nothing else. One keeps signed meeting minutes for a group of four. One presented with zero prep and somehow got full marks.

Tag your group project partner. You know what you did.

Which one are you in the group?
